versions.content: If the crypto primitive requires a buffer for the result, its memory location is referred by the pointer job->jobPrimitiveInput.outputPtr. On calling this function, job->jobPrimitiveInput. outputLengthPtr shall contain the size of the associated buffer. When the request has finished, the actual length of the returned value shall be stored. This applies analogously to job->jobPrimitiveInput.secondaryOutputPtr and job->jobPrimitiveInput.secondaryOutputLengthPtr, if they shall be used for the chosen crypto primitive. If the output is redirected to a key element, the output buffer of the respective key element has to be used instead.
